newsitem.title: USA: Hinsdale says Liberty merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Hinsdale says Liberty merger approved.

text.p: Hinsdale Financial Corp said its stockholders approved a proposed merger with Liberty Bancorp.
The combined entity will be named Alliance Bancorp and intends to pay a cash dividend at an annual rate of $0.65 per share, Hinsdale said.

Liberty shareholders will get 1.054 shares of common stock in Alliance for every share of stock they hold in Liberty, while Hinsdale shareholders will maintain one share of stock in Alliance for each share of stock of Hinsdale they own, said the bank holding company.
The Hinsdale stockholders' vote is subject to final certification, the company said.
Liberty shareholders approved the merger November 26.
Following completion of the merger, Alliance intends to repurchase up to 10 percent of its outstanding common stock, Hinsdale said.
The merger remains subject to approval by the Office of Thrift Supervision, which is expected in late December 1996 or January 1997, with the transaction to close shortly thereafter, Hinsdale said.
